conbody.p: Emergency braking will alert the driver with the Forward Safety warning light () blinking, a warning message, an audible warning and steering wheel vibration.
Emergency braking will be activated in following conditions.

li.p: Your driving speed: Approximately 30–130 km/h (19–80 mph)
Crossing vehicle and powered two-wheeler speed: Approximately above 10 km/h (6 mph)
